name: Crimson Freedom
description:
About This Game

Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game focused on single player experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet and the future of humanity. With base building, army management, resource systems, compelling campaigns, and strong, distinctive factions, our game delivers the pure RTS experience, enhanced with modern looks and thoughtful innovations. No gimmicks, just the timeless strategy you expect, done right.

The core experience centers around an extensive single-player narrative. Each campaign offers a unique perspective on the struggle for humanity’s future. You’re not just building bases and armies, you’re exploring the moral grey area of the red planet, and the choices and failures of humanity.

Set in a richly detailed sci-fi world, you’ll explore the future of humanity from three unique perspectives, gradually uncovering the full truth as you progress at your own pace. Crimson Freedom is designed as a love letter to the genre’s foundational mechanics. It features strong, asymmetrical factions - Red Rebellion, Orbis Concordia and the Ascentx - each with unique units, tech, and tactical strengths that fundamentally alter how you approach every engagement.

Experience the thrill of strategic warfare at a more relaxed pace. Focus on commanding epic battles and crushing your opponents without the stress of resource micromanagement or high APM demands, allowing for a laid-back and enjoyable gaming experience.
short_desc: Story-driven RTS set on Mars! Build bases, command armies and uncover the choices and failures of humanity. Each campaign offers a radically different perspective on the struggle for humanity's future, a conflict between freedom, control and a frenzied pursuit for immortality through AI.
